summary.intent: Fix a failing vault recovery E2E test in CI by diagnosing the root cause and getting it passing locally before committing to a PR.
summary.outcome: Identified and fixed a protobuf field number bug (field 2 vs field 1) in extractCidFromIpnsRecord, swapped IPNS resolution order to try delegated routing before IPFS gateway, and resolved all CodeRabbit review comments across three review rounds. PR #369 was created and merged.

repo: IPNS resolution in recovery.html uses two paths: delegated routing API (fast, works in CI with mock-ipns-routing) and direct IPFS gateway /ipns/ (slow, 15-30s timeout, fails in CI because Kubo can't resolve mock-published IPNS names)
mock-ipns-routing is a local tool in tools/mock-ipns-routing that must be built and running for E2E tests to pass
IPNS names are base36-encoded ed25519 public keys (k51...) — always [0-9a-z], always URL-safe
The web-e2e tests use Playwright with a default 30s timeout, configurable per-test

code.finding: extractCidFromIpnsRecord() parses IPNS protobuf records — the IPFS path value is in field 1 (not field 2 as originally coded); field 2 is signatureV1
resp.json() and resp.arrayBuffer() cannot both be called on the same Response — body is a one-time readable stream; protobuf parse must be in an else branch
Vault key blob resolution originally tried direct IPFS /ipns/ gateway first (30s timeout) before delegated routing — order needed to be swapped for CI compatibility
Test timeout was increased to 90s; assertion timeouts inside the test must be kept below the test timeout to avoid the assertion expiring before the test itself

workflow: Run E2E tests locally before pushing — saves a full CI round-trip for debugging
CodeRabbit reviews PRs automatically and leaves inline comments that need to be resolved
Use gh api graphql with resolveReviewThread mutation to programmatically resolve PR review threads
Reply to review comments via REST with --field in_reply_to=<integer_comment_id> (not -f) before resolving

friction: Had to read recovery.html in many separate chunks due to file size — no single read captured the full relevant context
Background service task notifications arrived mid-session after they were no longer needed (services already killed), creating noise
Three separate review rounds were required, each needing a full fetch-triage-fix-test-commit-push-reply-resolve cycle
The protobuf field bug was subtle — required inspecting compiled dist output to confirm field numbers rather than just reading source
open_items: The fetchWithRetry function only retries on thrown errors, not on non-OK HTTP responses (429/5xx) — partially addressed in final review round but worth auditing broadly across recovery.html
recovery.html is a large monolithic file that required many partial reads — potential candidate for refactoring into modules
Assertion timeouts in recovery.spec.ts were adjusted reactively; a shared timeout constant would prevent future drift between test timeout and assertion timeouts
